title: Industrial growth boundary change in Bill 139
summary: A Council committee voted 7-0, with 2 excused, to approve a revised CD1 version of Bill 139 and recommend passing it on first reading. The bill would add 85.57 acres in North Kīhei to the urban growth boundary for recycling, waste processing and light industrial uses. The Maui Planning Commission unanimously recommended approval, but the project still needs a State District Boundary Amendment and a zoning change, and the Council must hold a Maui public hearing.
